verdict.rationale: The docs say the CLI covers "instance lifecycle" and that the REST API (backed by a live OpenAPI spec) and a Python SDK give programmatic control of the whole platform. The CLI hello-world also walks through renting an instance and cleaning it up. However, the evidence never names separate start, stop, restart or destroy operations, and nothing describes how stopped or terminated instances are billed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of stop/start/restart/destroy commands or endpoints, evidence that billing stops (or what is still charged, e.g. storage) when an instance is stopped or destroyed, and independent hands-on corroboration.
